diagnosis:
# UNIFIED DIAGNOSIS: Memory Pressure During Training

## Root Cause
**Batch size (256) exceeds available CPU memory** under current data loading configuration. The combination of:
- Large batch_size=256 with no parallel I/O (num_workers=0)
- CPU-only training (use_gpu=False) on 2 Ray workers
- Gradient accumulation (accum_steps=2) loading full batches sequentially

results in memory exhaustion during the second training attempt.

## Critical Issue
All data is loaded into memory synchronously without asynchronous prefetching, forcing the system to hold the entire batch in RAM before processing.

## Recommended Actions (Priority Order)

| Action | Expected Impact | Effort |
|--------|-----------------|--------|
| **Reduce batch_size → 64–128** | Immediate 50–75% memory reduction | Critical
remediation_details: Reduced batch size from 256 to 128 and scaled accum_steps from 2 to 4 (invariant effective_batch_size=512)
